title: CSE472-Shilling-Attack-Detection-in-Recommender-Systems_ML_Project
summary: A machine learning course project for detecting shilling attacks in recommender systems, evaluated on datasets like MovieLens 100K, Tool Home, and Grocery Food. Its requirements.txt lists sdv, ctgan, and sdmetrics as dependencies, but no code in the evidence actually calls them.
evidence: notebook/requirements.txt: sdv, ctgan, sdmetrics listed; no matching usage pattern found in code
needs: No call sites found; unclear whether sdv/ctgan/sdmetrics are actually used to generate attack profiles or just listed as dependencies.
